entryPolicy.rule: All five replacement-cohort Threads will use the same bornAt and chronology endpoint; the replacement resets experimental material, not the frozen age/timing authority.

specificityPolicy.encoding: Existing GenesisWorldSpec authority: concrete locality/country facts live in places[].description and culturalContext; no parallel geography authority is introduced.
specificityPolicy.rule: Every replacement World must name an actual country and locality in the WorldSpec and provide enough factual cultural/institutional detail to constrain lived affordances. Concrete geography may not be converted into personality, morality, competence, politics, religion, ethnicity, dignity, willingness or future-profession conclusions.
minimumRequirements: country + locality explicitly named in culturalContext
places[] grounded in that locality rather than generic archetypes
language use situated rather than merely listed
mobility/institutions tied to the actual locality
at least five factual cultural/institutional anchors in culturalContext

freshnessWitness.note: Five replacement settings were selected and authored before replacement genomes or identities exist: Tbilisi (Georgia), Kaohsiung (Taiwan), Recife (Brazil), Fès (Morocco), and Hobart (Tasmania, Australia). Old H-v2 and recovery-v1 lives were not inspected for content selection and cannot be reused.

convergentPair.broadQuestion: How to act when formal procedures and everyday workarounds diverge.
convergentPair.constraint: The broad question is protocol-only and must never be passed to Pass A, Pass B, Pass C, record repair, genome generation or cohort publication. The worlds must remain attributable through different lived routes even if later meanings partially converge.

familiarityPolicy.calls: one stateless call per candidate world
familiarityPolicy.materiallyUnderrepresentedRule: densityScore <= 1 OR at least two coverage-domain scores <= 1
familiarityPolicy.replacementRule: A materially under-represented candidate is preserved as burned replacement-G1 evidence and replaced only by a newly authored candidate under a new manifest revision before any replacement genome exists. No replacement is allowed for aesthetics, personality, narrative quality or expected H performance.
familiarityPolicy.allPassRule: Only if all five candidates are not materially under-represented may the probe tool emit the five replacement-v1 final WorldSpec files with non-null familiarityProbe witnesses.

genomeBoundary.firstAllowedAfter: all five replacement G1 familiarity candidates accepted and final WorldSpecs frozen

inheritWithoutOutcomeDrivenChange: G4-v3 generation and mechanical reliability semantics
provider/model family and frozen cognition surfaces
G3 L L T L L T treatment rule
analysisAuthorityBoundary.freshGenomeCeilingReason: Old G5/G6 D3 text contains empirical G2 pair detectability learned from the old genomes. New genome material cannot inherit that empirical ceiling as fact. After replacement G1 finalization, fresh genomes must receive a fresh pre-life G2 ceiling and Gate-G(2) must explicitly reconcile that result with unchanged G5/G6 authority before any replacement life cognition.

lifeGenerationBoundary.firstAllowedAfter: blocking Gate-G(2) CLEAR on the complete replacement preregistration packet

nextStep.action: run cold replacement G1 familiarity probe locally
nextStep.onAllAccepted: freeze emitted final replacement WorldSpecs, then author fresh genomes without changing Worlds
nextStep.onAnyUnderrepresented: preserve result and candidate; author only a replacement World under a new manifest revision while genomes remain nonexistent
